goal: Build visual mockups for Finder, Safari, Notes, and System Settings.
summary: Phase 5 Core Apps Batch 1 completed. Finder, Safari, Notes, and System Settings are implemented as visual/interactive mockups: Finder with sidebar, toolbar, path bar, and navigable file grid; Safari with address bar, toolbar, tabs, and mocked webpage; Notes with searchable note list sidebar and editor; System Settings with nine-category sidebar and detailed panes (General, Appearance, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Notifications, Sound, Display, Battery, Privacy & Security). Verification: 62 unit tests pass, 12 e2e tests pass, production build succeeds. Added e2e coverage for settings category switching and fixed window-manager scoping to accommodate Safari tabs.
stepSummaries:
1. Implement Finder with sidebar, toolbar, path bar, and mocked file grid. [verified]
  2. Implement Safari with address bar, toolbar, tabs, and mocked web page content. [verified]
  3. Implement Notes with note list sidebar and note editor area. [verified]
  4. Implement System Settings with settings categories sidebar and detail panes. [verified]
